description: Ministry of National Co-existence Dialogue & Official Languages - Rules of Registration Criteria, Fee, etc., under the Micro Finance Act
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulatory rules and criteria for the registration of microfinance non-governmental organizations, issued under the authority of the Microfinance Act, No.6 of 2016. It establishes legal requirements, eligibility criteria, and application procedures, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
